LESSON: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN KENYA SITES SCENERIES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities
Topic 3.4: Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is wildlife important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main tourist attractions in Kenya
2. explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN KENYA SITES SCENERIES
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN KENYA SITES SCENERIES
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Identify main tourist attractions in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to identify main tourist attractions in Kenya. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify main tourist attractions in Kenya.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify main tourist attractions in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy

What this means
In this part you learn to explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

KEY FACTS: WILDLIFE AND TOURISM IN KENYA SITES SCENERIES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Example 1: Connect “Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: identify main tourist attractions in Kenya)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries. (skill: explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify main tourist attractions in Kenya.
3. Practise this skill: explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is wildlife important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify main tourist attractions in Kenya.
5. Be able to: explain contributions of wildlife and tourism to the economy.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
